slot.brief: Give five similar-looking words and ask which one comes third when arranged as in a dictionary; brief the author to include words sharing first two letters so third-letter comparison matters.

stem: Arrange these words in dictionary order: **cab, cabin, cable, cactus, cadence**. Which word comes third?

verdicts.working: Alphabetically: cab, cabin, cable, cactus, cadence. The third word is cable.

working:
Order: cab, cabin, cable, cactus, cadence. “cab” comes first as a prefix; cabin precedes cable because i precedes l. The third word is cable.

Independent check: Alphabetically: cab, cabin, cable, cactus, cadence. The third word is cable.
solution: Compare letters alphabetically: “cab” comes first as a prefix, followed by “cabin” and then “cable” since $i<l$. Thus, the third word is cable.
